mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (name, nickname, login_type, login_key, gender, date_birth, city, district, category, marketing_terms, login_email) VALUES (#{name}, #{nickname}, #{loginType}, #{loginKey}, #{gender}, #{dateBirth}, #{city}, #{district, typeHandler=com.wannabe.app.main.utility.mybatis.StringListHandler}, #{category, typeHandler=com.wannabe.app.main.utility.mybatis.StringListHandler}, #{marketingTerms}, #{loginEmail} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET state = #{state}, nickname = #{nickname}, date_deleted = #{dateUpdated, typeHandler=com.wannabe.app.main.utility.mybatis.LocalDateTimeHandler}, login_key = #{loginKey}, login_type = #{loginType}, gender = #{gender}, date_birth = #{dateBirth}, category = #{category, typeHandler=com.wannabe.app.main.utility.mybatis.StringListHandler}, city = #{city}, district = #{district, typeHandler=com.wannabe.app.main.utility.mybatis.StringListHandler}, verified_yn = #{verifiedYn}, marketing_terms = #{marketingTerms}, image_group_id = #{imageGroupId}, name = #{name}, device_token = #{deviceToken}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, point = #{point} WHERE id = #{id};
UPDATE t_user SET name = #{name}, nickname = #{nickname}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, gender = #{gender}, date_birth = #{dateBirth} WHERE id = #{id};
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.nickname, f.path AS profile_image_url FROM t_user u LEFT JOIN t_files f ON u.image_group_id = f.group_id WHERE u.id = #{userId};
SELECT * FROM t_article WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_type = 'ARTICLE' AND available_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY date_created DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page} * 10;
SELECT * FROM t_article WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_type = 'REVIEW' AND available_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY date_created DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page} * 10;
